about.title: About Us
about.heading: About Destitour
about.intro: Destitour is a local travel marketplace in Batam that brings Tour, Transport, and Hotel together in one platform. We were born from the need to make traveling to Batam as easy as ordering a meal from your phone.
about.story1: As locals, we know travelers need certainty: clear pricing, fast confirmation, and itineraries that actually work. That is why every package is hand-curated, prices are transparent with no hidden fees, and confirmations are sent within minutes via WhatsApp.
about.story2: From city tours, Barelang Bridge, and island hopping to transport and hotel services — everything can be arranged in one place. Our team is ready to help anytime, from planning to the end of your trip.
about.mission: To provide an easy, transparent, and trustworthy travel booking experience for everyone who wants to explore Batam.
about.vision: To be the most trusted local travel platform in Batam and the Riau Islands, known for fast service and honest pricing.

faq.title: FAQS
faq.heading: Common Questions
faq.q1: How do I book a package?
faq.a1: Choose your package, click Book Now, fill in the form (name, phone, dates, number of guests), then submit. You will get a booking code and wait for admin confirmation via WhatsApp.
faq.q2: Can I book without an email?
faq.a2: Yes. Email is optional. Confirmation is sent via WhatsApp to the number you registered.
faq.q3: How do I cancel or change a booking?
faq.a3: Contact the admin via WhatsApp with your booking code. Cancellation is confirmed directly by the admin.
faq.a4: No extra booking fees. The displayed price is the final package price; payment is discussed directly with the admin.
faq.a5: Yes, we accept group bookings. Write the number of guests and your needs in the notes field when booking, or contact us via WhatsApp.
